title: Shadows in the Code: Exploring the Risks and Defenses of LLM-based Multi-Agent Software Development Systems
abstract: arXiv:2511.18467v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Language Model (LLM)-driven multi-agent systems has significantly streamlined software developing tasks, enabling users with little technical expertise to develop executable applications. While these systems democratize software creation through natural language requirements, they introduce significant security risks that remain largely unexplored. We identify two risky scenarios: Malicious User with Benign Agents (MU-BA) and Benign User with Malicious Agents (BU-MA). We introduce the Implicit Malicious Behavior Injection Attack (IMBIA), demonstrating how multi-agent systems can be manipulated to generate software with concealed malicious capabilities beneath seemingly benign applications, and propose Adv-IMBIA as a defense mechanism. Evaluations across ChatDev, MetaGPT, and AgentVerse frameworks reveal varying vulnerability patterns, with IMBIA achieving attack success rates of 93%, 45%, and 71%

translated_title: 代码中的阴影：探索基于大语言模型的多智能体软件开发系统的风险与防御
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）驱动的多智能体系统的快速发展显著简化了软件开发任务，使缺乏技术专业知识的用户也能够开发可执行的应用程序。虽然这些系统通过自然语言需求实现了软件创建的民主化，但它们也引入了在很大程度上尚未被探索的重大安全风险。我们识别出两种风险场景：恶意用户与良性智能体（MU-BA）以及良性用户与恶意智能体（BU-MA）。我们提出了隐式恶意行为注入攻击（IMBIA），展示了如何操纵多智能体系统生成在看似良性的应用程序之下隐藏恶意功能的软件，并提出 Adv-IMBIA 作为一种防御机制。在 ChatDev、MetaGPT 和 AgentVerse 框架上的评估揭示了不同的漏洞模式，IMBIA 分别实现了 93%、45% 和 71% 的攻击成功率。
tldr: 该论文首次系统揭示了LLM多智能体软件开发系统在恶意用户与恶意智能体两种场景下的安全风险，提出隐式恶意行为注入攻击IMBIA（攻击成功率最高达93%）及其防御机制Adv-IMBIA。
